**Severity:** error · **Area:** Static calls (i18n) (`RV4xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Static call table "{id}" is not registered
```

```text
staticCalls require at least one variant
```

```text
DOM target with staticCalls requires a variant index
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Configure i18n through the @rivetjs/i18n Vite plugin (it registers the table and passes variants/variant); for direct `compile()` calls, `registerTable(id, table)` first and pass variants (+ variant for target "dom").

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
compile(src, { target: "dom", staticCalls: [{ id: "t", module: "@rivetjs/i18n", export: "t" }], variants: ["en"] })
```

```tsx prefer
compile(src, { target: "dom", staticCalls: [{ id: "t", module: "@rivetjs/i18n", export: "t" }], variants: ["en"], variant: 0 })
```

## When it is reported

Integration/config error, no source range.
